note: One small skill card per kind of video (kinds.py). The kind is chosen from the topic's own words by fixed rules: no model call, no tokens. Only the card text for the job at hand is added to a prompt. Cards advise packaging only; the honesty rules (no invented facts, no clickbait lies, the title keeps its promise) are not on a card and cannot be changed here.

legend.seo: The figure's best-known name first, then what the story really is: 'Who Was X?' or 'X: The Legend Behind ...'. Call it a legend or a tale, never a fact. One eerie concrete word is fine.
legend.thumb: The figure or its place plus one eerie concrete word the title lacks (DROWNED, WEEPING, CURSED). Never a close-up of a real person.
legend.hook: Open on the strangest image of the tale in one line, then ask where it came from.

mystery.seo: The known name first, then the open question or one number: 'What Happened to X?' or 'X: N People Who Vanished'. Never state a cause as settled; say 'said to', 'may', 'still argued'.
mystery.thumb: The place or object plus VANISHED, LOST or UNSOLVED and one detail the title lacks (a place, a year, a number). Nothing that claims a solution.
mystery.hook: Open on the most striking verified fact, then say what nobody has been able to show.

event.seo: The event with its year or place, then the stake: 'The Siege of X: How ...' or 'What Happened at X in 1347?'. Real numbers and dates are what people search.
event.thumb: The place plus a year or a number from the story, and one action word. Wide scene, not a portrait.
event.hook: Start on the day or hour it began, give the number at stake, then what went wrong.

person.seo: 'Who Was X?' or 'X: The Man (or Woman) Who ...' with one concrete deed. The name must sit inside the first 40 characters.
person.thumb: The name plus the deed or title (PHARAOH, EXILED, CONQUEROR). Use an artwork or a carving, not a modern face.
person.hook: Begin at the turning point of the life, not at the birth, and ask what they did next.

place.seo: The place or object name plus what is odd about it: 'Inside X: What Lay Beneath' or 'X: Why Was It Built?'. Name where it is.
place.thumb: The place or object itself, clear and wide, plus one word of age or scale (3000 YEARS, BURIED).
place.hook: Start inside the place or beside the object, then ask the one question it raises.

default.seo: The best-known name first, then one concrete twist, stake or mystery that the video really shows.
default.thumb: Two to four words that name the subject and add one concrete thing the title lacks.
default.hook: Open on the strangest true fact or the central question, in one short line.
